oneOf.const: Classic Smart (Discovery - Classic Smart plan; Discovery - Vitality 2025)
oneOf.title: Classic Smart - ~160 USD/mo

x-jsf-presentation.description: The Classic Smart Plan offers essential hospital cover through network hospitals, along with limited day-to-day cover for primary care such as GP visits, at fixed co-payments. It covers 27 chronic conditions through network providers, and specialist consultations require a referral from a network GP.

oneOf.const: Classic Delta Saver (Discovery - Classic Delta Saver Plan; Discovery - Vitality 2025)
oneOf.title: Classic Delta Saver - ~205 USD/mo

x-jsf-presentation.description: The Classic Delta Saver Plan provides full hospital cover at Delta network hospitals, with out-of-hospital medical expenses covered by a Medical Savings Account (MSA). Once the MSA is exhausted, there is no further day-to-day cover. It also covers 27 chronic conditions with access to network pharmacies and includes full specialist coverage if within the network.

oneOf.const: Classic Saver (Discovery - Classic Saver Plan; Discovery - Vitality 2025)
oneOf.title: Classic Saver - ~256 USD/mo

x-jsf-presentation.description: The Classic Saver Plan offers comprehensive healthcare coverage, including unlimited hospital care, chronic illness medication coverage, maternity benefits, and travel emergency medical support. Additionally, it includes the Day-to-Day Extender Benefit for essential health services once the Medical Savings Account is depleted.

oneOf.const: Classic Priority (Discovery - Classic Priority Plan; Discovery - Vitality 2025)
oneOf.title: Classic Priority - ~327 USD/mo

x-jsf-presentation.description: The Classic Priority Plan offers comprehensive healthcare coverage, including unlimited hospital care, chronic illness medication coverage, maternity benefits, and travel emergency medical support. Additionally, it includes a Day-to-Day Coverage: after the Medical Savings Account (MSA) is depleted, the employee gets a limited "Above Threshold Benefit" which gives them extra coverage for outpatient treatments.

oneOf.const: Classic Comprehensive (Discovery - Classic Comprehensive Plan; Discovery - Vitality 2025)
oneOf.title: Classic Comprehensive - ~525 USD/mo

x-jsf-presentation.description: The Classic Comprehensive Plan offers comprehensive healthcare coverage, including unlimited hospital care, chronic illness medication coverage, maternity benefits, and travel emergency medical support. Additionally, it includes a Day-to-Day Coverage: once the employee hits their Medical Savings Account (MSA) annual limit, they'll get an unlimited "Above Threshold Benefit" which ensures they're covered for outpatient treatments with no cap.
